card.name: Start of Symptomatic and Interstitial
card.fires_on: The opening piece "Sym" of "Symptomatic" at the start of a sentence or table row about heart or other adverse events in dose-modification text. Also the openings of "Interstitial" and "interquartile".

modes.label: Symptomatic at sentence start
modes.description: "Sym" begins "Symptomatic" right after a period or table heading, before heart failure, LVEF, or bradycardia.
